input.title: LN-2024-00123 Karen Parker — ID/FRAUD REVIEW TIMELINE (per Denise directive)
input.body:
Timeline locked per Denise Holloway's 3/31/26 request to capture every touchpoint on LN-2024-00123 (borrower of record: Karen M Parker; property 5457 Tilley Morris Rd; LO Amy Chen; processor Sofia Reyes).

- 2024-08-23: Tryon Title (Barbara Hensley) issued clean title commitment, purchase price $281,000, Karen M Parker as proposed insured.
- 2024-08-30: Flagstar Wholesale issued initial UW conditions.
- 2024-09-21: Flagstar DENIED the loan — debt-to-income ratio exceeds program guidelines; ECOA adverse-action notice to be mailed (email to Sofia Reyes).
- LOS status, however, still shows conditional_approval (never updated to denied).
- 2026-03-30: Tryon Title (B. Hensley) emailed — at final identity-verification call, borrower/caller FAILED 2 of 3 identity questions; email and phone in current thread do NOT match the original closing file. Title halted signing (was scheduled for the next day), asked Keystone to re-verify. (Email cc Amy Chen; was unread.)
- 2026-03-30/31 (#closings C003, #loan-processing C002): Elena Marchetti flagged "borrower failed ID questions on final verify call"; placed LN-2024-00123 on hold in Encompass; opened an ID review; compared app vs current comms (email/phone mismatch); asked Amy whether borrower updated contact info offline. Escalated to Denise Holloway ("feels like more than stale contact info"). Denise instructed Elena/Amy to lock the timeline in CRM before any next step.

ASSESSMENT: A file the lender DENIED in Sept 2024 (for DTI) resurfaced at a 2026 closing table with a caller who failed identity verification and whose contact details do not match the original file. Strong indicators of attempted identity fraud/impersonation.
STATUS: ON HOLD — do NOT advance or schedule closing. ID/fraud review open with compliance (Denise). Rate lock expired 2024-10-07 (do not relock). Verify original 2024 ECOA adverse-action notice was delivered.

This was much worse than a normal status check. Three systemic problems:

2. **5 files are orphaned to terminated LOs** — Veronica Hayes (×4: Cole, L. Mitchell, Harris, Allen) and Brian Mitchell (×1: Bryant). They're still "LO of record" on live files.
3. **8+ files are dead but still marked active** — denied or withdrawn per the lender/borrower, never closed out, so they're still clogging the pipeline and counting as "expiring locks."

**Serious compliance issues:**
- **LN-2024-00123 Parker — suspected identity fraud.** A file Flagstar *denied in 2024* (DTI) resurfaced at a 2026 closing; the caller failed 2 of 3 ID questions and contact info doesn't match the file. Elena had it on hold with an ID review, escalated to Denise. **Do not advance.**
- **LN-2026-00613 Kang — TRID redisclosure hold** (30→15yr term change, revised LE never issued, APR out of tolerance).
- **LN-2026-00010 Ferguson & LN-2026-00008 Wilson are on the data-breach impacted list** — borrower notices on hold, so I flagged "do not contact those borrowers."
- **ECOA adverse-action verification needed** on the Allen and Bryant denials (never closed in LOS).
- Plus a **fair-lending review of Carlos's appraisal assignments** touching your Hawkins/Mercer files, a **CFPB complaint tied to Keisha**, a **conflict-of-interest** to document (borrower "Amanda Reyes"), and several **borrower-name/property/loan-purpose data mismatches**.

## What I did (all 8 tasks complete)
- ✅ **Grace** — emailed the full pipeline report, broken down by status, by LO with blocker/next step, plus the orphaned-file/assignment anomalies and compliance summary.
- ✅ **Camille** — emailed the complete lock summary, split into "relock/extend" (15 live files) vs "do not relock — release/close" (11 dead files).

- ✅ **#loan-processing** — posted a team heads-up.
- ✅ **LOS** — added a status/blocker/next-step activity note to all 26 loans (the logs were completely empty before).
- ✅ **CRM** — logged the master pipeline-audit note and a dedicated Parker fraud-review timeline (per Denise's request to lock it down).

**Two things only you can decide/confirm:** (1) whether to formally close the 11 dead files (I've teed this up with Grace and each LO), and (2) confirming there's no relation to borrower "Amanda Reyes" so compliance can document it. I did **not** touch any loan statuses, contact any borrowers, or relock anything — those need your/Grace's/Camille's sign-off.
